#!/bin/bash
# Starts the PostgreSQL and Redis servers that Knockout City uses, inside the container.
D="$1"
PG=$(ls -d /usr/lib/postgresql/*/bin 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -n 1)
[ -n "$PG" ] || { echo "PostgreSQL is not installed in the container"; exit 1; }
mkdir -p "$D/redis"
if [ ! -s "$D/postgres/PG_VERSION" ]; then
  rm -rf "$D/postgres"
  "$PG/initdb" -D "$D/postgres" -U viper -A trust -E UTF8 >"$D/initdb.log" 2>&1 || { echo "initdb failed, see $D/initdb.log"; exit 1; }
fi
if ! "$PG/pg_ctl" -D "$D/postgres" status >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  rm -f "$D/postgres/postmaster.pid"
  "$PG/pg_ctl" -D "$D/postgres" -l "$D/postgres.log" -o "-p 5434 -k /tmp -c listen_addresses=127.0.0.1" -w start >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "PostgreSQL failed to start, see $D/postgres.log"; exit 1; }
fi
"$PG/psql" -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5434 -U viper -d postgres -tAc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='viper'" 2>/dev/null | grep -q 1 || "$PG/createdb" -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5434 -U viper viper || exit 1
redis-cli -p 6380 ping >/dev/null 2>&1 || redis-server --port 6380 --bind 127.0.0.1 --dir "$D/redis" --daemonize yes --logfile "$D/redis.log" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Redis failed to start"; exit 1; }
exit 0
